### 2026-10-07 — Okay it was my first time doing hardware so it took me a lot of time to figure out the software, install the footprint libraries and .sym etc etc. While the kicad software seemed easy, it was actually

**1.5h**

Okay it was my first time doing hardware so it took me a lot of time to figure out the software, install the footprint libraries and .sym etc etc. While the kicad software seemed easy, it was actually quite overwhelming at first. But eventually after watching yt videos and tuts and following the hack club starbie guide, i eventually got the hang of the software.

Here's what i did in this session:
1) Installed and set-up the software and got my hands dirty with it
2) Learnt how to place components, change values and how to add nets
3) MADE THE SCHEMATIC OF STARBIE
4) Learnt how to assign footprints and also did that.

Some problems i faced:
1) I faced a ton of problems while importing the footprint libraries and assigning them
2) My Software crashed but luckily i saved my progress beforehand
3) I misclicked again and again and had to watch a ton of videos to get the hang of the software

Overall it was kinda tough but fun at the same time, looking forward to complete these projects soon
